summary.en: New York in winter: five days working outward from Midtown Manhattan to Brooklyn and Queens, getting around by subway and on foot.
summary.zh: 冬天的纽约，五天从曼哈顿中城一路走到布鲁克林和皇后区，靠地铁和步行串起来。

note.en: AirTrain to the E train: about 1 hour, and far cheaper than a taxi
note.zh: AirTrain 转 E 线地铁，约 1 小时，比打车便宜太多

note.en: On East 51st St: tiny rooms but a great location, a 5-minute walk from the subway
note.zh: 东 51 街，房间很小但位置好，走到地铁 5 分钟

note.en: Went up to the observation deck in the early evening; the line is shortest half an hour before sunset
note.zh: 傍晚上观景台，日落前半小时排队人最少

note.en: The Chelsea Market branch; two adobada tacos are just right
note.zh: Chelsea Market 店，Adobada 玉米饼两个刚好

title.zh: 时代广场 · 博物馆日

note.en: Not crowded yet at 9 a.m., a good time for photos
note.zh: 早上九点人还不多，适合拍照

note.en: The Starry Night is on the fifth floor; head straight there, then work your way back down
note.zh: 《星月夜》在五楼，进门先直奔那层再往回逛

note.en: The Broadway location; grab a slice and eat it standing up
note.zh: 百老汇店，站着吃一角 pizza

note.en: Mirrored observation deck; I booked the dusk slot to catch both daylight and the city lights coming on
note.zh: 镜面观景台，预约的是黄昏场，能同时看到天亮和亮灯

note.en: An evening movie in a converted old theater; the lobby is worth a look
note.zh: 晚场电影，老剧院改的影院，大厅值得看看

note.en: Walked back to the hotel, a little over ten minutes
note.zh: 步行回酒店，十几分钟

title.zh: 中央公园 · 城市绿地

name.zh: 地铁 6 号线到 77 街

note.en: Entered the park from the east side, which is quieter than the south end
note.zh: 从东侧进公园，比南门清静

note.en: Walked from Bethesda Terrace all the way to The Ramble, which took more than three hours
note.zh: 从 Bethesda Terrace 一路走到 The Ramble，走了三个多小时

note.en: On West 74th St; eat the chocolate chip walnut cookie while it's warm
note.zh: 西 74 街，核桃巧克力曲奇趁热吃

note.en: An open-air ice rink in winter, with the string lights all lit up at night
note.zh: 冬天有露天溜冰场，晚上灯串全亮

note.en: Stayed another night in the same room
note.zh: 连住，没换房

note.en: Walked back over the Manhattan Bridge; the pedestrian path is on the south side
note.zh: 走曼哈顿桥回程，桥上人行道在南侧

note.en: Looking down on the East River from the bridge; it's very windy, so wear a hat
note.zh: 从桥上往下看东河，风很大记得戴帽子

note.en: The classic shot of the bridge framed between buildings; the light is best in the morning
note.zh: 经典的桥洞机位，早上光线顺

note.en: Coal-oven thin crust, with a shorter line than Grimaldi's next door
note.zh: 煤炉薄底，比隔壁 Grimaldi's 队短

note.en: The gilded reliefs at the entrance are worth stopping to look at, and you're free to wander inside
note.zh: 门口的金色浮雕值得站着看一会儿，里面可以随便进

note.en: Didn't get back until 10 p.m.; the front desk is open 24 hours
note.zh: 晚上十点才回，前台 24 小时

note.en: Checked out and left my bags at the hotel, then came back for them in the afternoon
note.zh: 退房寄存行李，下午回来取

note.en: A great angle on the Manhattan skyline, with almost no tourists
note.zh: 看曼哈顿天际线的角度很好，游客几乎没有

note.en: A roadside Mexican stand in Sunset Park, Brooklyn, cash only
note.zh: 布鲁克林日落公园的路边墨西哥摊，现金结账

note.en: Allowed two and a half hours; with the evening rush hour, that was just enough to avoid a scramble
note.zh: 留了两个半小时，赶上晚高峰刚好不慌
